path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "3", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The standard sentence for murder is—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "3", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: 30 years if the court, in determining sentence, is satisfied that the prosecution has proved beyond reasonable doubt that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "3", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person murdered was a custodial officer on duty or an emergency worker on duty; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "3", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: at the time of carrying out the conduct the accused knew or was reckless as to whether that person was a custodial officer or an emergency worker; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "3", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in any other case, 25 years.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "3", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See sections 5A and 5B of the Sentencing Act 1991 as to standard sentences.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 3A(1) amended by Nos 49/1991 s. 119(1) (Sch. 2 item 2), 48/1997 s. 60(1)(Sch. 1 item 2(a)(b)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "3A", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 37, "rect": {"page": 37, "x0": 462.7, "y0": 212.2, "x1": 511.3, "y1": 294.8}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "3A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A person who unintentionally causes the death of another person by an act of violence done in the course or furtherance of a crime the necessary elements of which include violence for which a person upon first conviction may, under or by virtue of any enactment, be sentenced to level 1 imprisonment (life) or to imprisonment for a term of 10 years or more shall be liable to be convicted of murder as though he had killed that person intentionally.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "3A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The rule of law known as the felony-murder rule (whereby a person who unintentionally causes the death of another by an act of violence done in the course or furtherance of a felony of violence is liable to be convicted of murder as though he had killed that person intentionally) is hereby abrogated.

heading: Manslaughter—single punch or strike taken to be dangerous act
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 4A inserted by No. 72/2014 s. 3.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "4A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 38, "rect": {"page": 38, "x0": 84.5, "y0": 164.8, "x1": 125.3, "y1": 201.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "4A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "4A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies to a single punch or strike that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "4A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is delivered to any part of a person's head or neck; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "4A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: by itself causes an injury to the head or neck.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "4A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A single punch or strike is to be taken to be a dangerous act for the purposes of the law relating to manslaughter by an unlawful and dangerous act.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "4A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of subsection (2), it is irrelevant that the single punch or strike is one of a series of punches or strikes.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "4A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A single punch or strike may be the cause of a person's death even if the injury from which the person dies is not the injury that the punch or strike itself caused to the person's head or neck but another injury resulting from an impact to the person's head or neck, or to another part of the person's body, caused by the punch or strike.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "4A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a person punches another person to the head, and that other person falls, hits their head on the road, and dies from the injury resulting from their head hitting the road, the punch may be the cause of their death.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "4A", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Nothing in this section limits the circumstances in which a punch or strike may be an unlawful and dangerous act for the purposes of the law relating to manslaughter by an unlawful and dangerous act.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "4A", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In this section—

heading: injury
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "4A", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "injury"}
text: has the same meaning as in Subdivision (4);

heading: strike
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "4A", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "strike"}
text: means a strike delivered with any part of the body.

history_json: [{"raw": "Notes to s. 4A amended by No. 14/2015 s. 69(7)(8).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "4A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 39, "rect": {"page": 39, "x0": 462.7, "y0": 245.8, "x1": 511.4, "y1": 282.4}, "confidence": "low"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "4A", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "strike"}
text:
Under section 11 of the Jury Directions Act 2015, after the close of all evidence and before the closing address of the prosecution, defence counsel must inform the trial judge whether each element of the offence is or is not in issue, including—
• whether the punch or strike was a dangerous act; and
• whether the punch or strike caused the person's death.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "4A", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "strike"}
text:
Under section 12 of the Jury Directions Act 2015, the prosecution and defence counsel must each request that the trial judge give, or not give, to the jury particular directions in respect of the matters in issue, which may include—
• whether the punch or strike was a dangerous act; and
• whether the punch or strike caused the person's death.

heading: Punishment of manslaughter

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 5A inserted by No. 7/2008 s. 3, amended by No. 16/2020 s. 4.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "5A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 40, "rect": {"page": 40, "x0": 84.5, "y0": 333.7, "x1": 128.5, "y1": 397.9}, "confidence": "high"}]

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 6A inserted by No. 7546 s. 2.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "6A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 42, "rect": {"page": 42, "x0": 84.5, "y0": 369.6, "x1": 130.4, "y1": 397.0}, "confidence": "high"}]

text: The rule of law whereby it is a crime for a person to commit or to attempt to commit suicide is hereby abrogated.

heading: Survivor of suicide pact who kills deceased party is guilty of manslaughter
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 6B inserted by No. 7546 s. 2.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "6B", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 42, "rect": {"page": 42, "x0": 84.5, "y0": 436.8, "x1": 130.4, "y1": 464.2}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "6B", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "6B", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Where upon the trial of a person for the murder of another person the jury are satisfied that the accused caused or was a party to causing the death of that other person by a wilful act or omission but are satisfied on the balance of probabilities that the act was done or the omission made in pursuance of a suicide pact then the jury shall, notwithstanding that the circumstances were such that but for the provisions of this section they might have returned a verdict of murder, return a verdict of manslaughter in lieu thereof.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "6B", "subsection": "1A", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: Any person who—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 6B(2)(a) amended by No. 10079 s. 8(c).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "6B", "sub_path": ["(2)", "(a)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 43, "rect": {"page": 43, "x0": 462.7, "y0": 384.5, "x1": 506.7, "y1": 421.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "6B", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "6B", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "6B", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: shall be guilty of an indictable offence and liable to level 6 imprisonment (5 years maximum); but if the jury are satisfied on the balance of probabilities that the acts constituting the offence were done pursuant to a suicide pact the jury shall return a verdict of guilty of the indictable offence of being a party to a suicide pact and the convicted person shall be liable to level 6 imprisonment (5 years maximum).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "6B", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The fact that by virtue of this section any person who in pursuance of a suicide pact has killed another person has not been or is not liable to be convicted of murder shall not affect the question of whether the homicide amounted to murder in the case of a third person who is a party to the homicide and is not a party to the suicide pact.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "1", "section": "6B", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of this section suicide pact means an agreement between two or more persons having for its object the death of all of them whether or not each is to take his own life; but nothing done by a person who enters into a suicide pact shall be treated as done by him in pursuance of the pact unless it is done while he has the settled intention of dying in pursuance of the pact.

text: Where any person being criminally stricken poisoned or otherwise hurt upon the sea or at any place out of Victoria dies of such stroke poisoning or hurt in Victoria, or being criminally stricken poisoned or otherwise hurt at any place in Victoria dies of such stroke poisoning or hurt upon the sea or at any place out of Victoria, every offence committed in respect of any such case, whether the same amounts to the offence of murder or of manslaughter or of child homicide or of homicide by firearm or of being accessory to murder or manslaughter or child homicide or homicide by firearm, may be dealt with inquired of tried determined and punished in Victoria in the same manner in all respects as if such offence had been wholly committed in Victoria.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 31C inserted by No. 3/2019 s. 3.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "31C", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 76, "rect": {"page": 76, "x0": 84.5, "y0": 287.3, "x1": 123.9, "y1": 323.8}, "confidence": "high"}]

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4", "section": "31C", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A person commits an offence if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4", "section": "31C", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4", "section": "31C", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: a person who holds a licence under the Firearms Act 1996, discharging a firearm the person is authorised to use under the licence in the course of the person's duties under—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4", "section": "31C", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4", "section": "31C", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

See section 5(2H) of that Act for the requirement to impose a custodial order for this offence unless the circumstances set out in paragraphs (a) to (e) of that section exist.

heading: Intimidation of a law enforcement officer or a family member of a law enforcement officer
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 31D inserted by No. 3/2019 s. 3.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "31D", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 78, "rect": {"page": 78, "x0": 84.5, "y0": 499.8, "x1": 123.9, "y1": 536.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4", "section": "31D", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4", "section": "31D", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A person commits an offence if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4", "section": "31D", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person uses or procures the use of intimidation towards another person (the victim); and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4", "section": "31D", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4", "section": "31D", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A person who commits an offence against subsection (1) is liable to level 5 imprisonment (10 years maximum).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4", "section": "31D", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of subsection (1)(a), a person uses intimidation towards a victim if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4", "section": "31D", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person engages in conduct that could reasonably be expected to arouse apprehension or fear in the victim for the safety of the victim; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4", "section": "31D", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4", "section": "31D", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4", "section": "31D", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In a proceeding for an offence against subsection (1) it is a defence to the charge for the accused to prove that conduct in respect of a victim referred to in paragraph (d), (e), (f) or (g) of the definition of law enforcement officer in subsection (8) was engaged in without malice—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4", "section": "31D", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the normal course of a lawful business, trade, profession or enterprise (including that of any body or person whose business, or whose principal business, is the publication, or arranging the publication, of news or current affairs material); or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4", "section": "31D", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4", "section": "31D", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: for the purpose of engaging in political activities or discussion or communicating with respect to public affairs.

heading: Guiding principles
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 34AC inserted by No. 37/2023 s. 3.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "34AC", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 85, "rect": {"page": 85, "x0": 462.7, "y0": 164.8, "x1": 503.5, "y1": 201.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AC", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: It is the intention of Parliament that in interpreting and applying this Subdivision, courts are to have regard to the fact that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AC", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: non-fatal strangulation of a person by a current or former intimate partner indicates that the person is, statistically, significantly more likely to be killed by the current or former intimate partner; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AC", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in circumstances of family violence, non-fatal strangulation can indicate an ongoing and escalating pattern of coercive and controlling behaviour by the perpetrator; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AC", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: even very short or individual instances of non-fatal strangulation can demonstrate the perpetrator's physical dominance and control over the victim and create an atmosphere of fear and compliance; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AC", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: non-fatal strangulation will not always leave physical signs or injuries, and it can result in physical signs or injuries that only appear after weeks or months have passed.

heading: Non-fatal strangulation intentionally causing injury
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 34AD inserted by No. 37/2023 s. 3.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "34AD", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 85, "rect": {"page": 85, "x0": 462.7, "y0": 512.3, "x1": 503.5, "y1": 548.8}, "confidence": "high"}]

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AD", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AD", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 34AE inserted by No. 37/2023 s. 3.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "34AE", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 86, "rect": {"page": 86, "x0": 84.5, "y0": 431.4, "x1": 125.3, "y1": 468.0}, "confidence": "high"}]

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AG", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AG", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AG", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AG", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Sexual activity and consent defence—circumstances in which a person does not consent
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 34AH inserted by No. 37/2023 s. 3.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "34AH", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 88, "rect": {"page": 88, "x0": 84.5, "y0": 340.7, "x1": 125.3, "y1": 377.2}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of section 34AF(1)(b), circumstances in which a person does not consent to the conduct constituting the offence include, but are not limited to, the following—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person does not say or do anything to indicate consent to the conduct;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: economic or financial harm;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person submits to the conduct because of force, a fear of force, harm of any type or a fear of harm of any type, whether to that person or someone else, regardless of—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: when the force, harm or conduct giving rise to the fear occurs; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether it is, or is a result of, a single incident or is part of an ongoing pattern;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Each of the following is a type of harm that can be done to a person as described in this paragraph—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: reputational harm;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: harm to the person's family, cultural or community relationships;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: harm to the person's employment;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: family violence involving psychological abuse or harm to mental health;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person submits to the conduct because the person is overborne by the abuse of a relationship of authority or trust;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: sexual harassment.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": "c", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person submits to the conduct because of coercion or intimidation—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person is asleep or unconscious;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "g", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person is so affected by alcohol or another drug as to be incapable of consenting to the conduct;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "h", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person is so affected by alcohol or another drug as to be incapable of withdrawing consent to the conduct;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "h", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This circumstance may apply where a person gave consent when not so affected by alcohol or another drug as to be incapable of consenting.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "i", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: regardless of when the coercion or intimidation occurs; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "ii", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether it is, or is a result of, a single incident or is part of an ongoing pattern;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "ii", "subparagraph": "d", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person submits to the conduct because the person is unlawfully detained;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AH", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "i", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: having given consent to the conduct, the person later withdraws consent to the conduct taking place or continuing.

heading: Sexual activity and consent defence—reasonable belief in consent
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 34AI inserted by No. 37/2023 s. 3.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "34AI", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 90, "rect": {"page": 90, "x0": 84.5, "y0": 164.8, "x1": 125.3, "y1": 201.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AI", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AI", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of section 34AF(1)(b)(ii), whether or not A reasonably believes that B is consenting to the conduct constituting the offence depends on the circumstances.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AI", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See section 34AJ for the effect of intoxication on the standard to be applied in determining whether A had a reasonable belief.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AI", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A's belief that B consents to the conduct constituting the offence is not reasonable if, within a reasonable time before or at the time the conduct takes place, A does not say or do anything to find out whether B consents to the conduct.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AI", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (2) does not apply if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AI", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A has a cognitive impairment or mental illness (other than the effects of intoxication that is self-induced within the meaning of section 34AJ); and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AI", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that cognitive impairment or mental illness is a substantial cause of A not saying or doing anything to find out whether B consents to the conduct constituting the offence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AI", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A bears the burden of proving on the balance of probabilities the matters referred to in subsection (3).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AI", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: References to A and B in this section are references to the same A and B referred to in section 34AE.

heading: Sexual activity and consent defence—effect of intoxication on standard to be applied in determining reasonable belief
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 34AJ inserted by No. 37/2023 s. 3.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "34AJ", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 91, "rect": {"page": 91, "x0": 462.7, "y0": 164.8, "x1": 503.5, "y1": 201.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AJ", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AJ", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In determining whether a person who is intoxicated has a reasonable belief at any time—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AJ", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the intoxication is self-induced, regard must be had to the standard of a reasonable person who is not intoxicated and who is otherwise in the same circumstances as that person at the relevant time; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AJ", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the intoxication is not self-induced, regard must be had to the standard of a reasonable person who is intoxicated to the same extent as the person and who is in the same circumstances as that person at the relevant time.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AJ", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of this section, intoxication is self-induced unless it came about—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AJ", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: involuntarily; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AJ", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: because of fraud, sudden or extraordinary emergency, accident, reasonable mistake, duress or force; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AJ", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: from the use of a drug for which a prescription is required and that was used in accordance with the directions of the person who prescribed it; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AJ", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: from the use of a drug for which a prescription is not required and that was used for a purpose, and in accordance with the dosage level, recommended by the manufacturer.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AJ", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: However, intoxication that comes about in the circumstances referred to in subsection (2)(c) or (d) is self-induced if the person using the drug knew, or had reason to believe, when taking the drug that it would significantly impair the person's judgement or control.

heading: No defence of mistaken but honest and reasonable belief regarding relationship
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 34AK inserted by No. 37/2023 s. 3.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "34AK", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 92, "rect": {"page": 92, "x0": 84.5, "y0": 247.6, "x1": 125.3, "y1": 284.2}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AK", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For an offence against section 34AD(1) or 34AE(1), it is not a defence to a charge that, at the time of the conduct constituting the offence, A was under a mistaken but honest and reasonable belief that A was not a family member of B.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "4A", "section": "34AK", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Consent means free and voluntary agreement.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See also sections 37A and 37B which set out the objectives of Subdivisions (8A) to (8G) and the guiding principles that the courts are to have regard to in interpreting and applying those Subdivisions, including this section and section 36AA.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A person does not consent to an act just because they do not resist the act verbally or physically.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A person does not consent to an act just because they consented to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a different act with the same person; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the same act with the same person at a different time or place; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the same act with a different person; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a different act with a different person.

heading: Reasonable belief in consent
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 36A inserted by No. 47/2016 s. 5, substituted by No. 38/2022 s. 8.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "36A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 107, "rect": {"page": 107, "x0": 462.7, "y0": 238.0, "x1": 512.7, "y1": 302.2}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Whether or not a person (A) reasonably believes that another person (B) is consenting to an act depends on the circumstances.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See section 36B for the effect of intoxication on the standard to be applied in determining whether a person has a reasonable belief.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A's belief that B consents to an act is not reasonable if, within a reasonable time before or at the time the act takes place, A does not say or do anything to find out whether B consents to the act.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (2) does not apply if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A has a cognitive impairment or mental illness (other than the effects of intoxication that is self-induced within the meaning of section 36B); and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that cognitive impairment or mental illness is a substantial cause of A not saying or doing anything to find out whether B consents to the act.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A bears the burden of proving on the balance of probabilities the matters referred to in subsection (3).

heading: Circumstances in which a person does not consent
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 36AA inserted by No. 38/2022 s. 5.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "36AA", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 104, "rect": {"page": 104, "x0": 84.5, "y0": 428.1, "x1": 125.3, "y1": 464.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Circumstances in which a person does not consent to an act include, but are not limited to, the following—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person does not say or do anything to indicate consent to the act;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: economic or financial harm;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person submits to the act because of force, a fear of force, harm of any type or a fear of harm of any type, whether to that person or someone else or to an animal, regardless of—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: when the force, harm or conduct giving rise to the fear occurs; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether it is, or is a result of, a single incident or is part of an ongoing pattern;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Each of the following is a type of harm that can be done to a person as described in this paragraph—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: reputational harm;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: harm to the person's family, cultural or community relationships;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: harm to the person's employment;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: family violence involving psychological abuse or harm to mental health;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person submits to the act because the person is overborne by the abuse of a relationship of authority or trust;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: sexual harassment.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": "c", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person submits to the act because of coercion or intimidation—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person is asleep or unconscious;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "g", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person is so affected by alcohol or another drug as to be incapable of consenting to the act;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "h", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person is so affected by alcohol or another drug as to be incapable of withdrawing consent to the act;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "h", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This circumstance may apply where a person gave consent when not so affected by alcohol or another drug as to be incapable of consenting.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "i", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: regardless of when the coercion or intimidation occurs; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "ii", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether it is, or is a result of, a single incident or is part of an ongoing pattern;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "ii", "subparagraph": "d", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person submits to the act because the person is unlawfully detained;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "i", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person is incapable of understanding the sexual nature of the act;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "j", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person is mistaken about the sexual nature of the act;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "k", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person is mistaken about the identity of any other person involved in the act;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "l", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person mistakenly believes that the act is for medical or hygienic purposes;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "m", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the act occurs in the provision of commercial sexual services and the person engages in the act because of a false or misleading representation that the person will be paid;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "n", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the act involves an animal, the person mistakenly believes that the act is for veterinary or agricultural purposes or scientific research purposes;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "o", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person engages in the act on the basis that a condom is used and either—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "o", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: before or during the act, any other person involved in the act intentionally removes the condom or tampers with the condom; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "o", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person who was to use the condom intentionally does not use it;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "p", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: having given consent to the act, the person later withdraws consent to the act taking place or continuing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36AA", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of subsection (1)(m), a false or misleading representation may be made by words or conduct (including by omission) and may be explicit or implicit.

heading: Effect of intoxication on standard to be applied in determining reasonable belief
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 36B (Heading) amended by No. 38/2022 s. 9.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "36B", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 108, "rect": {"page": 108, "x0": 84.5, "y0": 164.8, "x1": 128.5, "y1": 210.6}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "S. 36B inserted by No. 47/2016 s. 5.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "36B", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 108, "rect": {"page": 108, "x0": 84.5, "y0": 216.8, "x1": 125.3, "y1": 253.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36B", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36B", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In determining whether a person who is intoxicated has a reasonable belief at any time—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36B", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the intoxication is self-induced, regard must be had to the standard of a reasonable person who is not intoxicated and who is otherwise in the same circumstances as that person at the relevant time; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36B", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the intoxication is not self-induced, regard must be had to the standard of a reasonable person who is intoxicated to the same extent as that person and who is in the same circumstances as that person at the relevant time.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36B", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of this section, intoxication is self-induced unless it came about—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36B", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: involuntarily; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36B", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: because of fraud, sudden or extraordinary emergency, accident, reasonable mistake, duress or force; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36B", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: from the use of a drug for which a prescription is required and that was used in accordance with the directions of the person who prescribed it; or

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 36B(2)(ca) inserted by No. 5/2018 s. 4(1)(a), repealed by No. 34/2019 s. 46(a).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "36B", "sub_path": ["(2)", "(ca)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 108, "rect": {"page": 108, "x0": 84.5, "y0": 551.9, "x1": 128.8, "y1": 616.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36B", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 36B(2)(d) amended by Nos 5/2018 s. 4(1)(b), 34/2019 s. 46(b).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "36B", "sub_path": ["(2)", "(d)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 108, "rect": {"page": 108, "x0": 84.5, "y0": 631.1, "x1": 128.5, "y1": 686.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36B", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: from the use of a drug for which a prescription is not required and that was used for a purpose, and in accordance with the dosage level, recommended by the manufacturer.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 36B(3) amended by Nos 5/2018 s. 4(2), 37/2023 s. 4.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "36B", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 109, "rect": {"page": 109, "x0": 462.7, "y0": 164.8, "x1": 506.7, "y1": 210.6}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "36B", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: However, intoxication that comes about in the circumstances referred to in subsection (2)(c) or (d) is self-induced if the person using the drug knew, or had reason to believe, when taking the drug that it would significantly impair the person's judgement or control.

heading: Care, supervision or authority
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 37 substituted by No. 81/1991 s. 3, amended by Nos 81/1997 s. 4, 2/2006 s. 4, substituted by No. 57/2007 s. 3, repealed by No. 74/2014 s. 7(3), new s. 37 inserted by No. 47/2016 s. 5.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "37", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 109, "rect": {"page": 109, "x0": 462.7, "y0": 247.6, "x1": 512.7, "y1": 413.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "37", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "37", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Without limiting the circumstances in which a child is under the care, supervision or authority of a person, a person (A) has a child (B) under their care, supervision or authority if A is—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "37", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: B's parent or step-parent; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "37", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: B's teacher; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "37", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: B's employer; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "I", "division": "1", "subdivision": "8", "section": "37", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: B's youth worker; or
